Testing Events

Spying on the shared emitter instead of mocking it, and the extra Prisma calls comment.service.js's tests now need to mock.

  • Spying on the Shared Emitter

    jest.spyOn keeps the real EventEmitter working while recording every emit() call — assert on what fired, not on what listeners then did.

  • Mocking One More Prisma Call

    createComment now queries Prisma twice, not once — comment.service.test.js's mocks grow to match, or the recipient-resolution code has nothing to run against.
